UnitStatement: Exports IPC channel name constants API_KEY_STORE_CHANNEL ('chirality:api-key-store'), API_KEY_REMOVE_CHANNEL ('chirality:api-key-remove'), and API_KEY_STATUS_CHANNEL ('chirality:api-key-status').
Exports type ApiKeyStatusResult { hasKey: boolean; encryptionAvailable: boolean; source: 'ui' | 'env' | 'none' }.
Exports type ApiKeyStoreResult { ok: boolean; error?: string }.
registerApiKeyHandlers() first calls unregisterApiKeyHandlers() to clear any existing handlers before registering, ensuring idempotent re-registration.
The API_KEY_STORE_CHANNEL handler rejects non-string or empty/whitespace-only keys, returning { ok: false, error: 'Key must be a non-empty string' }.
The store handler trims the key, calls storeApiKey(key.trim()), and returns { ok: true }; on error it returns ok:false with the error message.
The API_KEY_REMOVE_CHANNEL handler calls removeApiKey() and returns { ok: true }, or ok:false with the error message on failure.
The status handler computes envKey from process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (trimmed).
Status source resolution precedence: 'ui' if a UI key is stored, else 'env' if an env key exists, else 'none'.
Status handler returns hasKey = uiKeyStored OR envKey, encryptionAvailable from isEncryptionAvailable(), and the resolved source.
unregisterApiKeyHandlers() removes the store, remove, and status IPC handlers via ipcMain.removeHandler.
API Key Storage Adapter (DEL-02-06) encrypts and persists an Anthropic API key using Electron safeStorage; the encrypted blob is stored in the app userData directory outside projectRoot.
Invariant: API key material MUST NOT appear in logs, config files, or git-tracked locations.
On store/remove the adapter also sets/clears a process-global variable so the same-process Next.js server can read the key without IPC round-trips.
Storage constants: STORAGE_FILENAME = 'api-key.enc' and process-global key name GLOBAL_KEY = '__CHIRALITY_UI_API_KEY__'.
getStoragePath() returns app userData path joined with 'credentials' subdirectory and the storage filename.
ensureStorageDir() creates the storage directory recursively before writing.
storeApiKey(key) throws 'Secure storage is not available on this platform' if safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable() is false.
storeApiKey encrypts the key with safeStorage.encryptString, ensures the dir, writes the encrypted blob to disk, and sets the process global to the plaintext key.
retrieveApiKey() returns null when encryption is unavailable, when the file cannot be read, or when decryption fails.
On decryption failure retrieveApiKey does NOT auto-delete the corrupted blob (per Procedure Step 4b.2), so an operator may investigate.
removeApiKey() clears the process global to undefined then removes the storage file, tolerating a non-existent file.
hasStoredApiKey() returns true if the process global is set, else attempts to read the storage file (true if present, false otherwise) without retrieving the key value.
isEncryptionAvailable() returns safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable().
loadStoredKeyIntoGlobal() retrieves the stored key and loads it into the process global on startup; called once from electron/main.ts after app.whenReady().
getUiApiKey() reads the UI-provided API key from the process global; used by server-side anthropic-agent-sdk-manager.ts to implement ENV+UI precedence without IPC.
Defines constants: SELECT_DIRECTORY_CHANNEL = 'chirality:select-directory' and RUNTIME_NETWORK_POLICY_ID = 'REQ-NET-001'.
Default renderer probe timing: DEFAULT_RENDERER_PROBE_DELAY_MS = 1500 and DEFAULT_RENDERER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000.
Network policy allowlists: ANTHROPIC API hostname 'api.anthropic.com' and loopback hostnames 'localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]'.
RENDERER_EGRESS_FILTER_URLS filters http://*/*, https://*/*, ws://*/*, and wss://*/* for the egress policy.
parsePositiveInteger(raw, fallback) parses a base-10 integer, returning the fallback unless the result is a safe integer greater than 0.
readRendererProbeUrls() reads CHIRALITY_NETWORK_POLICY_PROBE_URLS, splitting on commas and trimming/filtering to non-empty values.
evaluateRendererEgressPolicy(rawUrl) returns INVALID_URL category with reason 'url_parse_failed' when the URL cannot be parsed.
For api.anthropic.com, egress is denied unless protocol is https: (reason anthropic_protocol_not_allowlisted) and port is empty or 443 (reason anthropic_port_not_allowlisted).
Egress to allowed loopback hostnames is permitted; any other host is denied with NETWORK_POLICY_VIOLATION reason host_not_allowlisted.
registerRendererEgressPolicy(window) hooks webContents.session.webRequest.onBeforeRequest over the filter URLs, allowing or cancelling each request per the egress decision.
Blocked outbound requests are logged via console.warn with category, policy REQ-NET-001, reason, url, method, resourceType, and webContentsId.
runRendererNetworkProbe(window) returns early when there are no configured probe URLs.
Probe delay and timeout are read from CHIRALITY_NETWORK_POLICY_PROBE_DELAY_MS and CHIRALITY_NETWORK_POLICY_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS via parsePositiveInteger.
The probe injects JavaScript that fetches each URL with method GET, mode 'no-cors', cache 'no-store', and an AbortController timeout, collecting per-URL results.
Probe results are executed via window.webContents.executeJavaScript and logged under '[network-policy-probe]' with the policy id; errors are logged via console.error.
The probe is scheduled after did-finish-load if the main frame is still loading, otherwise scheduled immediately (both via setTimeout with delayMs).
resolveInstructionRootForProcess() resolves CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT env override if set, else process.resourcesPath when packaged, else __dirname/../.. .
registerDirectorySelectionHandler() registers the select-directory IPC handler that opens a directory-only dialog titled 'Select Working Root'.
The directory selection handler returns { cancelled: true } when the dialog is canceled or no path is chosen.
The selected path is validated via stat; non-directory returns error 'Selected path is not a directory' and inaccessible paths return 'Selected path is not accessible'.
On a valid selection the handler returns { cancelled: false, path: selectedPath }.
startPackagedRendererServer() loads the renderer from process.resourcesPath/app.asar, dynamically imports next, and creates a Next app with dev:false.
The packaged renderer creates an HTTP server delegating to the Next request handler and listens on port 0 bound to 127.0.0.1 (OS-assigned port).
If the server address is missing or a string, it throws 'Renderer server failed to bind a TCP port'.
startPackagedRendererServer returns a RendererServer with a close() that awaits server.close and a url of http://127.0.0.1:<port>.
createMainWindow creates a 1280x840 BrowserWindow with show:false and webPreferences preload preload.js, contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true.
The main window registers the egress policy, loads the renderer URL, and runs the network probe; it is shown on the 'ready-to-show' event.
On app.whenReady the app registers the directory handler and API key handlers, loads the stored key into the global, and sets CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT.
Renderer URL is the packaged server URL when app.isPackaged, otherwise ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL or the default 'http://localhost:3000'.
On macOS 'activate', a new main window is created when no windows are open.
If renderer runtime initialization fails, the error is logged and app.quit() is called.
On 'window-all-closed' the app quits unless the platform is darwin (macOS).
On 'before-quit' the app removes the select-directory handler, unregisters API key handlers, and closes the packaged renderer server if present.
Preload defines the IPC channel constants for select-directory and the api-key store/remove/status channels.
Preload uses contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('chirality', ...) to expose a renderer-facing API under window.chirality.
The exposed chirality API includes platform (process.platform) and versions for chrome, electron, and node.
Exposed selectDirectory() invokes the select-directory IPC channel; apiKey exposes store(key), remove(), and status() invoking their respective channels.
next-env.d.ts references the 'next' and 'next/image-types/global' type definitions and is annotated as a file that should not be edited.
next.config.mjs exports a NextConfig with reactStrictMode: true.
